datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on November 26, 2023
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of November 26, 2023, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20231126]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery (optical and SAR) acquired on November 26, 2023 was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to delineate observed flood extent polygons. The resulting flood maps represent the actual spatial distribution of inundation caused by typhoon-induced rainfall and storm surge, enabling post-event impact assessment and hazard tracking.

sources.name: Philippine Space Agency
sources.description: Satellite image processing and analysis to delineate actual flood extent from optical and synthetic aperture radar imagery during the November 2023 typhoon event
